b'# tinydl

A small command-line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the bytes to a file (or to stdout), retrying on failure.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

Run it with:

```
python -m app.cli URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `URL` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin -q
```
'
